catch_copy: The long-awaited new entry in the hit 3D puzzle game “Fruit Mountain” — where you merge fruits to make them bigger — is coming to Nintendo Switch™ 2!
description:
The mega-hit 3D puzzle game "Fruit Mountain" — where you merge fruits to make them bigger — is now a party battle game for everyone!
This time, it's a fruit battle!? Jump into versus mode with up to 4 players!
With items and wild surprises, it's a chaotic battle full of laughs!
Keep stacking those fruits!

[Easy to Play!]
Just toss fruits onto the plate and stack them up.
Merge two of the same fruit to create a bigger one!
The bigger the fruit you make, the higher your score climbs!
Be careful not to let fruits fall off the plate — merge them skillfully!
Master your stacking technique and take on your rivals!

[Battle Together!]
・Compete against rivals worldwide online!
Create a Room and invite friends to battle anytime, anywhere!
・Local versus play offline too!
Up to 4 players can play locally on a single Nintendo Switch 2! Get everyone together for some fun!

[Tons of Game Modes!]
Multiple versus modes! Try different styles and have a blast!
・Standard Race
・Thief Frenzy
・Fruit of the Sun
・Great Harvest
・Survival

[Single Player Too!]
Hone your skills against NPCs and prepare for online battles!
In "Time Attack" mode, race to complete a watermelon as fast as you can!
Aim for the fastest time! Climb the rankings!

[Collection]
Customise your plate with the dress-up feature! Show off your style with your favourite plate!

upgrade_description:
◆Frame Rate
Improved frame rates provide smoother gameplay.

◆GameShare
With just one copy of the software, you can use "GameShare" with nearby people or "GameChat" members online, allowing up to four players to play together on their own screens.
